idea: Use LP dual sensitivity to guide splitting. Solve the compaction LP for the current best layout, read the dual prices of the containment and adjacency constraints, and split, merge or delete the squares with the most favourable marginal value per unit count change. Re-solve after each edit, which gives a targeted descent across counts n±1, n±3 instead of random moves.
